posts.text: AUREWAS is heading to Festival Idea Putrajaya 2026 — Innovation Challenge (18 November). Our PLC-based conveyor automatically separates metal, plastic and paper using inductive, capacitive and photoelectric sensors.
Represented UniMAP at the 2026 Ningbo International University Students & Sister Cities Youth Exchange Camp, hosted by Ningbo Polytechnic University in Zhejiang, China (18 – 24 October).

Completed Phase 1 of DICE 4.0 — the Kem Digital Kreatif at UniSZA — with Pasukan UniMAP. Field references from Muzium Negeri Terengganu and Kampung Budaya Terengganu are now shaping Galeri Warisan Maya.
